ero.name: tekstareo
ero.description: Fixture Ero: the tekstareo of Spec 011 ②, trimmed to what the fixture needs.

props.name: kind
props.description: What kind of text is written: text, or code (source text, Markdown) in the code typography without the platform's spelling check.

props.name: value
props.description: The current text, over several lines.

props.name: rows
props.description: How many lines the area shows before it scrolls; it grows only when a person drags it taller.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: An example in the empty area; never the label (Regulo placeholder-not-label).

props.name: required
props.description: Must be filled in; marked visibly and audibly (Regulo required-marked).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Not available; skipped by the keyboard.

props.name: invalid
props.description: The text is wrong; true whenever the slot error is filled (constraint).

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the label and the text on the scale of the kampo, so a text area and a field read alike in one form.

props.name: name
props.description: The name in the form; without effect in a design tool.

constraints.kialo: An error text without the error state is a contradiction a screen reader cannot resolve: it reads a fault on a field that says it is fine.
Two reasons why one cannot type are one too many; disabled wins.
